title: Oven Roasted Polish Chicken Skewers
description: A charred and shaggy Polish dish perfect for date night, featuring garlic clove and tempering chocolate, made paleo friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Once the chicken is done, brush the melted chocolate over the top of each skewer.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
